pages.title: A obra e a situação

work.title: Cast Away
work.note: Cast Away é um filme de 2000 dirigido por Robert Zemeckis, com Tom Hanks no papel de Chuck Noland, funcionário de uma empresa de entregas cujo avião cai no oceano. A obra conversa com o foco porque a aula transforma esse contexto em hoje você aprende meio e instrumento: We leave by boat. I tie it with a rope. We cook with a fire. We signal by waving. A referência mostra um náufrago e o que usa: by boat, with a rope.

pages.question: Como a história dessa obra ajuda você a imaginar a situação de hoje? Diga uma ideia em inglês.

items.wrong: When the oven stopped, I cooking.
items.fix: I was cooking when the oven stopped.
items.why: Use was cooking for the long action.

teach.goal: Como não traduzir palavra por palavra.
solo: Pergunte por que o erro acontece em português e como evitar.
group: Compare erro e forma natural: We was working. → We were working. | I was cut onions. → I was cutting onions. | When the oven stopped, I cooking. → I was cooking when the oven stopped..
Peça que digam a forma natural em voz alta.
extra90: Cada aluno cria um erro típico seu e o grupo corrige.

errors.w: When the oven stopped, I cooking.

facts.label: O que você estava fazendo
facts.sub: Use was/were + -ing para a ação longa e when + passado simples para o fato rápido: I was cooking when the oven stopped.

facts.label: Passado contínuo
facts.sub: Use was/were + -ing para uma ação que estava acontecendo: I was cutting onions. We were working. Use was com I, he, she e it, e were com you, we e they.

facts.label: Quando
facts.sub: Use when para o fato rápido que interrompe: I was cooking when the oven stopped. O fato rápido fica no passado simples: stopped, came, fell.

pages.title: A hot kitchen · 1/3
paragraphs: It is late at night in a restaurant kitchen in Halifax. The last guests leave the dining room. Steam rises from the big pots. Lia wipes her face with a towel. Chef Rosa comes in with two cups of water. They talk about the busy night.
“Hi, Lia! What were you doing at six o’clock?” says Rosa. “I was cutting onions when the guests came.” says Lia. “And what was Sam doing?” says Rosa.
